basic_info.description: 3-block walk to Lafayette Park in Pacific Heights.  Fantastic Doggie park and tennis courts in the park.  Modern Luxury 1-Bedroom, 1-Bath Condo at The Rockwell West Tower -Upper Floor with City Views, lots of windows, and an abundance of natural light. Features upgraded light White Oiled European Oak flooring throughout (DuChteau-The Vernal Collection). Enjoy 9' ceilings, built in Bosch and Liebherr appliances, washer/dryer, central heating and cooling , and your very own open-air private balcony with sweeping views and an excellent deeded parking space, large enough to accommodate an SUV. Interior 673 sq ft plus 40.205 sq ft exterior balcony.  Total 713 sq ft of indoor and outdoor living. Middle Parking dimensions: L-197 inches, w-75 inches, h-79 inches and a max weight of 4,400 lbs. Amenities include; 24/7 Front Desk, Gym, Courtyard with BBQ Grill, Residence Lounge, Bike Room, Media Room, Sky Lounge, Sky Deck with fire pit and views of Russian Hill and Nob Hill. Great staff/mgmt. Fantastic financials and reserves. Tesla and Chevy Bolt for hourly rent for the residents and their guests. Whole Foods around the corner. You can still submit a back up offer.
